maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from defense and intelligence contracts and new infrastructure design, engineering and program management, not repair or servicing of installed bases.

publicly_funded.reason: Main customers are US federal government (defense, intelligence) and public infrastructure agencies such as transit and transportation authorities.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through contract wins and organic growth; acquisitions such as TRS are occasional tuck-ins, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Provides national security, missile defense, C5ISR and critical infrastructure programs with clearances and incumbency, making switching costly and risky.
